tips.navigation.commandPalette: Press `⌘K` anywhere to jump to a project, start a chat, or run a command.
tips.navigation.approvalBanners: Approvals show up as banners in the chat — no extra windows to hunt down.
tips.search.allChats: `⌘⇧F` searches across every chat, prompt, and journal note.
tips.chat.newInSelectedProject: `⌘N` starts a new chat in the project you have selected.
tips.sessions.newRecentProject: `⌘T` opens a new session — pick from your recent projects.
tips.projects.openFolder: `⌘O` opens any folder on disk as a project right away.
tips.editor.toggleBesideChat: Use `⌘⇧.` to show or hide the editor beside your chat.
tips.tasks.taskMode: `⌘⇧T` switches to Task mode for work on a separate branch.
tips.navigation.sidebarEditorShortcuts: Jump to the sidebar with `⌘1` and back to the editor with `⌘2`.
tips.composer.slashShortcuts: Type `/` in the input bar for shortcuts like `/clear`, `/plan`, and `/branch`.
tips.composer.attachProjectFile: Type `@` to attach a file from your project to the next message.
tips.composer.sendImageByDrag: Drag a screenshot onto the chat box to send it as an image.
tips.composer.pasteImage: Paste an image from your clipboard with `⌘V`.
tips.models.remembersPerAgent: The model chip remembers the last model you picked for each agent.
tips.models.effortDial: The effort dial controls how carefully the agent thinks before acting.
tips.composer.stopReply: Press `Esc` while a reply is running to stop it.
tips.composer.followUpShortcut: Use `⇧↵` for a new line, `↵` to send, and `⌘↵` to queue a follow-up.
tips.composer.permissionModes: Switch permission modes from the composer — ask first, auto, or full access.
tips.composer.contextRing: The small ring next to the model name shows how full the chat context is.
tips.composer.planMode: Plan mode lets the agent outline an approach before editing files — toggle it from the composer.
tips.providers.multipleAgents: Run Claude, Codex, Grok, Kimi, Cursor, and OpenCode from the same window.
tips.localModels.onMac: Start a chat with a model on your Mac from the model list — nothing leaves your computer.
tips.settings.defaultAgent: Set the default agent for new chats in Settings → General.
tips.providers.independentSignIn: Each agent keeps its own sign-in — connect Anthropic, OpenAI, and others independently.
tips.models.fastOrStrong: Pick a faster model for quick tasks and a stronger one when you need deeper work.
tips.sidebar.manageChat: Right-click any chat in the sidebar to rename, archive, fork, or pin it.
tips.sidebar.pendingApproval: A pulsing amber dot means a chat is waiting for your approval.
tips.sidebar.unreadCompletion: A green dot means a chat finished while you were away — click to mark it read.
tips.sidebar.pinnedChatsStayVisible: Pinned chats stay at the top of their project, even when archived.
tips.sidebar.recentActivity: Chats sort by recent activity so the freshest ones stay on top.
tips.sidebar.resize: Drag the sidebar edge to resize it; double-click the edge to snap back.
tips.sidebar.collapseProjects: Collapse a project with the chevron — hidden chats stay safe.
tips.editor.builtInBesideChat: The built-in editor opens files beside your chat without leaving agmux.
tips.editor.fileActions: Right-click a file in the tree to rename, delete, or copy its path.
tips.editor.quickOpen: `⌘P` in the editor opens quick-open across the whole project.
tips.editor.unsavedChanges: Edited files show a dot on their tab until you save.
tips.editor.openChatDiff: Click a diff in chat to jump straight to that file in the editor.
tips.terminal.copySelection: Hold Shift while selecting text in a terminal to copy it, even in full-screen mode.
tips.notifications.backgroundApprovals: Approval prompts still reach you when the window is in the background.
tips.notifications.noDuplicateApproval: You will not get the same approval notification twice.
tips.notifications.history: Notification history keeps recent alerts so you can catch up later.
tips.remote.phoneApprovals: Pair your phone under Remote Control to approve or answer from anywhere.
tips.tasks.isolatedBranch: Task mode keeps main branch work separate so experiments stay isolated.
tips.tasks.links: Each task can track its own branch, pull request, and issue links.
tips.tasks.stopOrArchive: Stop a task to keep its files; archive it when you are fully done.
tips.tasks.diffSummary: The `+N −M` badge on a chat shows lines added and removed as the agent works.
tips.tasks.commitDialog: The commit dialog finds modified, new, and staged files for you.
tips.appearance.themes: agmux ships with a dozen themes — switch them in Settings → Appearance.
tips.appearance.glass: Adjust glass blur and border strength under Settings → Appearance.
tips.appearance.fonts: Pick a UI font and a code font that suit you — defaults are Geist and Geist Mono.
tips.appearance.animations: Set animations to smooth, quick, or off for accessibility.
tips.appearance.lightMode: Light mode is fully supported — toggle it in Settings → Appearance.
tips.editor.openExternal: Open the project in Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or another editor from the chat top bar.
tips.settings.multiView: Multi-view in Settings lets you put two chats side by side.
tips.updates.releaseChannel: Choose stable, beta, or off for automatic updates.
tips.sessions.restore: Claude chats restore when you reopen the app — scrollback is kept.
tips.journal.decisions: The journal panel records key decisions for a chat so you can find them later.
tips.sessions.forkChat: Fork a chat from the menu to branch the conversation without losing the original.
tips.search.archivedChats: Archived chats still show up in search — nothing is truly gone.
tips.usage.estimatedCost: Usage shows estimated tokens and cost per agent, per day.
tips.sessions.resumeTerminal: Resume a background terminal from the sidebar anytime.
tips.editor.openMention: Hold `⌥` while clicking a file mention to open it in the editor without leaving chat.
tips.composer.optimizePrompt: Use the optimize control on the composer to polish your prompt before sending.
tips.skills.shortcuts: The Skills tab holds reusable prompts you can run with `/`.
tips.sidebar.pinShortcut: Pin a chat, then jump back with `⌘1` from anywhere.
tips.multiView.dragToSplit: In multi-view, drag a tab onto another pane to split your workspace.
tips.localModels.browse: Browse and download local models in Settings → Local Models.
tips.localModels.eject: Eject a loaded local model from the chat bar to free memory; the next message loads it again.
tips.remote.openChats: With Remote Control, your phone can open the same chats as your Mac.
tips.teams.privacy: Teams only shares hourly usage summaries — never your prompts or code.
tips.editor.ideShortcut: `⌘⇧.` is a quick way into IDE mode — try it when you need the file tree.
tips.projects.rememberSelection: agmux remembers your last selected project across launches.
tips.appearance.lightModeAccent: Light mode keeps the same accent colors with lighter surfaces.
tips.whatsNew.reopen: After an update, What's New opens automatically — press `⌘?` anytime to reopen it.
tips.sessions.quitCleanly: Quitting agmux cleanly stops every running agent session.
tips.home.greetingChanges: The home screen greeting verb changes each time you return.
